Container.Name: Maison
Container.Overview: Maison is a lightweight self-hosted dashboard for managing Docker apps on a single host. It is a dashboard-only reimagining of CasaOS: same look, same feel, same app store — but stripped down to a home screen for your apps and a store to install more. Ships as one container: a Go binary with Svelte UI, no database required.
Container.Description: Lightweight Docker app dashboard and store. One container, no database, CasaOS App Store compatible.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Host path for app data. Apps installed by Maison bind their volumes here.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for managing containers on the host

Config.Name: Host Proc
Config.Description: Host /proc mount for system resource monitoring

Config.Name: DATA_ROOT
Config.Description: Data folder path inside the container

Config.Name: DATA_HOST_PATH
Config.Description: Host path of the data folder. Must match the Data Path mount source.
